title: Third download: two hours of experiencing multiple timelines

tellings.quote: And it came to me at a place where my whole world shattered for two hours where I was experiencing multiple timelines really

plain: In what he calls his third "download", a Hollywood writer named Brent Friedman says his whole world shattered for two hours while he experienced several timelines at once. Friedman tells Jesse Michels this from his own experience, as one of a series of moments when knowledge came to him from outside himself.
